findings.title: harness:doctor fails on scrubbed wallets.json already on main
findings.controlFlow: npm run harness:doctor → harness/cli.ts doctor forbids tracked wallet*.json; file is a scrubbed aggregate summary (manualReview=9, fingerprints only) from OPERATOR-CONSOLE-SHELL-001 on main, not introduced by Hotpath tip delta beyond a one-line summary fix.
findings.impact: Gate reports FAIL even though offline product/security gates pass and no private wallet bulk is present. Risk of false-blocking future Hotpath merges if treated as P0 without classification.
findings.reproduction: On tip 5734591: npm run harness:doctor → status FAIL, error 'forbidden tracked files for wallet*.json: apps/operator-console/src/data/fixtures/wallets.json'.
findings.recommendedBoundedRepair: Narrow harness doctor allowlist for scrubbed operator-console fixture summaries OR rename fixture outside wallet*.json pattern; do not reopen M0.

findings.title: Task catch path may apply stale provider metrics snapshot
findings.controlFlow: runTask assigns metrics = budgeted.executor.metrics after factory (pre-flight snapshot), re-reads only after pilot returns. catch (error) applies that metrics variable. If pilot throws after real HTTP consumes, providerRequestCount can remain 0 while requests were made. Primary budget-refuse mid-enumerate path returns partial inside LiveHelius instead of throwing, so hotpath budgetStop success path is correct.
findings.impact: Unexpected transport exceptions may under-report request counts; status mapping still sets failed/blocked/partial via message, but accounting telemetry can be wrong.
findings.reproduction: Inject sourceFactory that consumes via executor then throws a non-budget Error after N fetches; observe task.providerRequestCount may be 0 after failed status.
findings.recommendedBoundedRepair: In catch, re-read budgeted.executor.metrics (hoist budgeted outside try or store ref) before applyMetrics; add unit test for mid-flight throw metrics integrity.

findings.title: createOperatorApiServer accepts non-loopback host without fail-closed
findings.controlFlow: options.host defaults to 127.0.0.1 but any string is stored on __bindHost and passed to server.listen. Product CLI run-operator-api.ts hardcodes host: '127.0.0.1'. Host header allowlist still rejects non-loopback Host on requests, but bind address itself is not validated.
findings.impact: Misuse of library API could bind public interfaces; CLI entry path is safe. Defense-in-depth gap vs 'no public bind without fail-closed'.
findings.reproduction: Call createOperatorApiServer({ host: '0.0.0.0', service }) then listenOperatorApi — server listens on all interfaces without throw.
findings.recommendedBoundedRepair: In listenOperatorApi / createOperatorApiServer, reject host not in {127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1} unless explicit dangerous opt-in that still fails closed for production scripts.

note: No P0/P1. Advisories only. Auditor did not modify implementation.
